newsitem.title: JAPAN: S&P assigns A- to KLTCB $100 mln FRN.
newsitem.headline: S&P assigns A- to KLTCB $100 mln FRN.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Corp said on Wednesday that it had assigned its A- rating to Korea Long-Term Credit Bank's (KLTCB) $100-million one-year unsubordinated floating-rate notes.
The notes are issued under the bank's Euro medium-term note programme, which has recently been expanded to $2 billion from $1 billion, S&P said in a statement.
The outlook for the rating is stable, S&P said.
KLTCB's asset quality and operating profitability should enable it to maintain its performance as the Korean banking environment becomes more competitive, S&P said.
Eventual changes in the rating would reflect the bank's performance as the banking sector deregulates, particularly its success in reaching its goal of becoming a universal bank, S&P said.
